boundSummaries.description:
All the {@link App.Metric.EvaluatableSpec} discoverable in the {@link App.Metric.Container}
and their descriptions.

evalResults.description: All the results of evaluating the {@link #boundSummaries} in index order

evaluatable.description:
The {@link App.Metric.Evaluatable} instance that evaluated all the {@link #boundSummaries}
and produced {@link #evalResults}

partialSpec.description:
The partial spec applied to each {@link metrics} in {@link #boundSummaries} to construct a
{@link App.Metric.EvaluatableSpec}.

title:
The result of evaluating a {@link App.Metric.Container.Summary}. Contains references
to the evaluation context - {@link App.Metric.Evaluatable} instance and parameters of of evaluation.
name: App.Metric.Container.Summary.Result
